identification: Watercolour of a steep river gorge with a road cut into the cliff, snowy peaks behind, signed lower right 'W. Menzies Gibb' (William Menzies Gibb, NZ/Australian, 1859-1931). Likely a New Zealand gorge scene (Buller or Otira type). Framed, mounted, under glass.

(2) Australian and NZ auction results: Leonard Joel, Mossgreen, Davidson Auctions, Theodore Bruce, Webb's, Mowbray, Art+Object, International Art Centre (NZ) for 'Menzies Gibb'. (3) LiveAuctioneers and Invaluable results for 'Menzies Gibb watercolour'. (4) Also check Design & Art Australia Online and Artprice for his auction range, and compare signed gorge/coach road scenes of similar size (about 30x25 cm).
viewing_check: Check the signature under glass in good light (confirm 'W. Menzies Gibb' and look for a title or date on the mount or backing), and look at the back for labels or gallery stickers. Check for foxing, toning or fading at the sheet edges (mount may hide it), and confirm it is a hand watercolour, not a print. Note image size. Local Armitage results suggest small Menzies Gibb pieces have gone cheaply, so size and subject quality matter.
